title: kaiak usage totals
description: The control plane's usage totals as one gateway gets them: the data of a totals event on that gateway's stream, the only way totals travel. A consistent snapshot: its windows include every batch the control plane had counted when it read them, and no other. Complete: it lists every hour and month limit window of the current config with usage in the control plane's current window; a limit it does not list has used nothing there. Per-minute limits are not listed (each gateway enforces its share locally).

live_gateways.description: Gateways in the live set. Each divides its per-minute limits by this count (at least 1), and enforces its share of every backend max_in_flight cap: ceil(max_in_flight / live_gateways), at least 1.

counted_through.description: The last usage batch the control plane has counted for the stream's gateway instance; null before its first. Included in the windows: the gateway stops counting that batch and every earlier one of the epoch as its own.

batch_position.description: A batch within its gateway's epochs: the epoch and the sequence (usage-batch.schema.json, batch_id).

window.description: One limit's current window: the limit's identity (group or global, and type — as in config), the window start and the amount used.

group.description: The group the limit belongs to. Absent for a global limit.

type.description: Limit types counted by the control plane: fixed UTC hours and calendar months.

window_start.description: Start of the window, UTC: the top of an hour for tokens_per_hour, the first of a month for usd_per_month.

used.description: tokens_per_hour: tokens (tokens_in + tokens_cache_write + tokens_out; input read from the cache does not count); usd_per_month: nano-USD.
